# Catalog, Views, and RLS Checklist: Unified Table Processing and Atomic Transaction Optimization

**Purpose**: Review whether the written design keeps `pg_catalog` as a preserved in-memory catalog, leaves room for later SQL views over shared tables, requires shared-table row-level security to survive the reorganization, and tells implementers to reuse stable optimized code as the reference instead of replacing it with a new body.
**Created**: 2026-10-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are `pg_catalog` relations required to remain in this feature as in-memory projections whose current query results stay valid? [Completeness, Spec §US2 scenario 10, Spec §FR-047]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the set of `pg_catalog` relations that must keep their current projection named, rather than only the catalog family? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-044, Spec §FR-047]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements specified for a later SQL view whose base table is a shared table, including that the view reads through the unified shared provider? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-038]
- [ ] CHK004 Is shared-table row-level security required to remain supported after the provider reorganization? [Completeness, Gap, Spec responsibility table, Data Model §1.3]
- [ ] CHK005 Are shared-table RLS read predicates and write checks both required, including policy checks on insert and update? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-003, Contract §2.2]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the spec require stable optimized routines to stay the reference, so a reorganization adapts them instead of replacing them with a newly written body? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §US2 scenario 8, Spec §FR-044]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the optimized behaviors that must be carried forward named, including hot scan, covering aggregates, indexed equality updates, `pg_catalog` projections, and shared RLS binding? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §US2 scenario 7, Spec §FR-047]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "keep the specialized projection" defined as retaining current `pg_catalog` projection behavior, not only sharing one provider shell? [Clarity, Spec §FR-047, Spec §US2 scenario 10]
- [ ] CHK009 Are later user-defined views distinguished from virtual `system.*` views and from `pg_catalog` relations? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-038]
- [ ] CHK010 Is shared-table RLS defined with its policy mode, the actor it applies to, and the statements it covers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Data Model §1.3]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "delete superseded copies" defined so duplicate wrappers may go away while the optimized function body remains the source to move or call? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-044, Spec §US2 scenario 8]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Do FR-047 and the plan agree that each `pg_catalog` relation keeps its projection and only the hand-written schema list is removed? [Consistency, Spec §FR-047, Plan summary]
- [ ] CHK013 Does the responsibility-table mention of RLS mode match a functional requirement that shared tables keep forced policy checks? [Consistency, Spec responsibility table, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK014 Does US2 scenario 8's instruction to delete replaced implementations agree with a requirement to reuse stable optimized code as the reference? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §US2 scenario 8, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK015 Does a later view over a shared table stay consistent with shared RLS, and stay distinct from `pg_catalog` remaining an in-memory projection? [Consistency, Gap, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-041]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Can `pg_catalog` preservation be decided from SC-015, which measures one introspection query and does not name per-relation result parity? [Measurability, Spec §SC-015, Spec §US2 scenario 10]
- [ ] CHK017 Is there a measurable outcome that shared-table RLS still hides and rejects the same rows for the same policies after the provider change? [Acceptance Criteria, Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK018 Is there a measurable limit on how much of an optimized module may be rewritten, as distinct from moved or called? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §SC-005, Constitution §I]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements specified for a `pg_catalog` query through HTTP SQL and through a wire session, with the same relation results? [Coverage, Spec §US2 scenario 10, Spec §US6]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements specified for select, insert, update, and delete on a shared table under RLS, including a view that selects from that table? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements specified so creating a view on a shared table later does not require a second scan implementation? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-038]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined when a shared-table RLS policy matches zero rows, and when a write fails the policy check? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined when a view over a shared table is queried by an actor who does not pass the base-table policy? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for a `pg_catalog` relation whose current projection applies role checks that must stay inside that projection? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-047, Data Model §1.3]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK025 Is non-regression of `pg_catalog` introspection latency specified separately from user and shared table latency? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-015, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK026 Is non-regression of the existing hot-scan, covering-aggregate, and equality-update paths required when they move under the shared engine? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-002, Spec §SC-009, Constitution §I]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK027 Does the spec state that stock DataFusion `information_schema` relations stay outside the Kalam `pg_catalog` projection work? [Dependency, Spec §FR-047, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the assumption that consolidation deletes old providers reconciled with keeping their optimized internals as the reference? [Assumption, Conflict, Spec §US2 scenario 8, Spec Assumptions]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [ ] CHK029 Is it specified which `pg_catalog` behaviors this feature must preserve, and which changes are only schema-source cleanup? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-044, Spec §US2 scenario 11]
- [ ] CHK030 Does the spec tell an implementer to start from the current shared RLS and `pg_catalog` projection code, and to change only the duplication the inventory names? [Ambiguity, Gap, Spec §FR-044, Constitution §I]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
